reviewMethod: All 18 selected stored SVG files across five current-corpus articles were independently rehashed against the frozen GitHub evidence archive, byte-length checked, XML-parsed, rendered on white and visually reviewed against the owning paper theme plus each isolated Figure/Scheme caption. Task/page/article/source DOI bindings, captureVersion 6.2.20, job IDs, media generation 1790082000000, content-addressed R2 keys, current public media index, public publication ledger and existing same-ID body figures were checked. The two newly marked JOC rows had their canonical evidence fingerprints independently recomputed and matched the server markers; older unmarked rows were accepted only after equivalent frozen-byte/source/caption evidence was independently checked. Capture reports or success markers were provenance evidence only and were not treated as semantic approval. No publisher recrawl, R2 write, server-side import/repair, literature-data change, scope change or userscript change was performed.
quality: All 18 approved files are SVG captures that parse and render successfully, with no external HTTP image references. Candidate full SHA256 values are unique and none collides with a current published TOC/body-file hash. Existing official TOCs for the four Organic Letters papers remain distinct source assets and are preserved. JOC 10.1021/acs.joc.6c01653 currently has no official TOC; this packet adds only missing Scheme 3 and Scheme 6 alongside its existing reviewed body figures. Organic Letters 10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03356 keeps its existing Scheme 2; this packet adds Scheme 3 and Scheme 4. For 10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03248, Scheme 2 is not present in this frozen selection and remains unapproved/pending without blocking the six individually verified figures in this packet.
